scope.focus: FrankEye structured CPU vision -> Qwen3.5 native multimodal replacement -> implications for current dissolved Retina plus adaptive MVC target
scope.non_overlap: Project-Frankenstein vision architecture lineage; complements but does not duplicate the Drive Digital-Retina measurement/dictionary shard.

lineage.event: Introduced unified FrankEye while replacing older frank_visual_pipeline/frank_adaptive_vision modules. FrankEye combined Digital Retina/CNN, DINOv2, GoL-derived features, OCR and face detection in a CPU-only path.
Connected FrankEye to screenshots and WebUI image uploads, making perception an operational tool path.
Split Describe vs Transcribe behavior: full FrankEye analysis versus OCR-only Tesseract path.
Vision bugfix lineage removed useless CIFAR/DINOv2 output for screenshots, added screenshot-specific app/tab/OCR behavior and improved dark-theme OCR preprocessing.
Architecture pivot replaced FrankEye calls with tools.native_vision and switched the recommended vision backend to Qwen3.5 native multimodal.
Frozen head declares native Qwen3.5 vision replaces FrankEye entirely: no CNN, DINOv2, ONNX or Tesseract. Images become multimodal model requests and the public result is natural-language text.

negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.result: Late PF collapsed multiple explicit visual submodules into one native multimodal model call.
negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.impact: Lower operational complexity, but no explicit structured familiarity/calibration/prototype surfaces required by the current adaptive visual learner contract.

negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.result: Frozen native_vision returns natural-language description/OCR text rather than typed evidence with feature-backbone version, classifier identity, calibration and open-set state.
negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.impact: Natural-language perception can be a semantic layer, but cannot by itself satisfy current provenance, replay, rollback and user-specific familiarity requirements.

negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.result: FrankEye historical fixes show richer structured pipelines can emit misleading classifier/DINO output on screenshots and require modality-specific gating.
negative_results_and_architecture_tensio.impact: Reintroducing Retina/MVC structure must be contribution-tested; do not restore old components wholesale.

cross_source_reconciliation.with_drive_retina_receipt: Drive history recovered useful prototype/dictionary/replay/open-set measurement lineage. PF later removed that style of explicit structure in favor of native VLM integration. Current target should treat them as complementary layers rather than choosing one historical branch wholesale.
cross_source_reconciliation.current_architecture_hypothesis: Use native Qwen3.5 vision as high-level semantic interpretation while retaining a dissolved typed Retina/MVC evidence plane for user-specific familiarity, calibration, replay, routing and rollback. The model consumes evidence but is not its authority.
cross_source_reconciliation.counterhypothesis: Native-VLM-only may dominate structured Retina/MVC on accuracy and simplicity; test on recurring user-specific classes, OOD negatives, latency/resource cost, reproducibility and online adaptation.

current_inheritance.delta: Three-arm perception differential: native-VLM-only vs structured MVC/Retina-only vs fused native-VLM + MVC. Preregister identity/familiarity accuracy, open-set FPR/AUROC, calibration, repeatability, latency, RAM/CPU and routing savings.
Keep multimodal semantic vision integrated with the core model, but expose familiarity/known/unknown/conflict as typed evidence rather than prose-only self-report.
Express image evidence and semantic interpretation as separate typed layers with feature/model versions, provenance, confidence/open-set state and rollback-compatible classifier identity.
Persist visual evidence/prototype state separately from generated descriptions; link them by observation id and model/version provenance.
Graph sensor evidence, classifier/prototype lineage and model interpretation as distinct node/edge classes so generated descriptions cannot overwrite sensor truth.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Compare native VLM text classification, MVC centroids and fused evidence on a frozen recurring-person/object/user-specific set plus near-neighbor/OOD negatives.
Repeat identical images across process restarts/prompt variants and measure typed-evidence stability separately from prose variance.
Lesion MVC while preserving native VLM, then rescue identical stored prototype state; measure routing/user-familiarity impact.
Lesion native VLM while preserving MVC; verify familiarity/open-set routing remains operational.
Measure screenshot modality separately because historical FrankEye needed modality-specific suppression of irrelevant classifiers.

earned_work.reason: Strong architecture/negative-result inheritance overlaps Drive Retina mapping; deduplicate before credit.

level0_effect.reason: Targeted PF history/semantic shard only; global PF tree/history denominator remains unfrozen.

branch_feedback.emergenz: DELTA: lesion/rescue native-VLM and MVC layers independently before attributing fusion benefit.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: DELTA: preserve alternative visual hypotheses/evidence facets rather than collapsing early to one prose label.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: store feature/prototype/model versions and observation links separately from generated descriptions.
branch_feedback.harness: DELTA: require native-VLM-only vs MVC-only vs fused differential plus screenshot regression set.
branch_feedback.clayresearch: DELTA: historical simplification pivot is a counterhypothesis against overengineering; measurements decide the final stack.
